generator.params.bud_area.note: The leaf area its `bud` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: the bud is now its flower closed, where before it drew the fruit ovoid.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Jepson 1925, Dicentra formosa, Fig. 404, p. 405: naked scape-like flowering stems 8 in to 18 in high, a little taller than the leaves (Abrams vol. 2, p. 234, gives the basal leaves as 3 dm to 5 dm long but no scape height).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.petal_who.note: Jepson's Manual (1925), Fumariaceae (in Papaveraceae here): sepals 2, small and scale-like, and petals 4 in 2 dissimilar pairs. So four petals, an outer and an inner pair (drawn alike).

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a delicate herb with lacy, fern-like, blue-green leaves and arching stems hung with pink, heart-shaped flowers. Each stalk ends in one nodding raceme drawn as a cluster (flowers 1, flower_size 0.1 within the 5 cm to 15 cm the species states; its look's inflorescence 8 flowers, each a fifth of its length, bent 60 degrees), now that Papaveraceae's flowers are mostly in racemes; before, the stalk bore 8 single flowers. leaf_area 0.337 is what its lobed leaf card draws on an organ 1 m long since the lobed card takes its lobes, depth and width from the traits (nightshades round 5). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.4 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green leaves; pink flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): four pink petals by hand (in two pairs; the drawing has no joined heart-shaped corolla) above two sepals, six stamens and a pistil of two carpels, from the characters of Papaveraceae and Dicentra by the rules at the flowering plants.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

generator.params.bud_spacing.note: The flowers hang in a short cluster at the top of the nodding stalk, and the buds at its tip about half as far apart as the open flowers by eye (flowering photographs, observations 78668413, 156536515, 159323269, 396852962, 171777385, 27542805, 165256931, 217405336): a bud's internode as a share of a flower's, judged by eye.
